context: This paper presents the first polynomial kernel for the Face Cover Number problem, with a cubic dependence on the parameter. For a restricted version of the problem – where the embedding is provided as part of the input and the terminal set includes all vertices of the graph – a linear kernel was previously known. A natural direction for future research is to close the gap between the kernel sizes for the embedded and non-embedded variants of the problem. Open Question 1.
